svg.title: Proof size grows with the logarithm
svg.desc: An inclusion proof needs one 32-byte hash per level: 96 bytes for 8 entries, 320 for a thousand, 640 for a million, 960 for a billion, 1,280 for about a trillion. One ML-DSA-44 signature is 2,420 bytes.

text.tspan: every doubling of the log adds one hash: 32 bytes
